# Vendored dependencies

`index.js`, `sqlite.worker.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm` are from
[sql.js-httpvfs](https://github.com/phiresky/sql.js-httpvfs) 0.8.12 (Apache-2.0),
copied verbatim from its npm `dist/` so the demo runs without a network fetch or a
build step.

`annlite/` is generated by `make demo` from this repository's own `annlite-wasm`
crate and is not committed.

## A measurement about this library

sql.js-httpvfs treats `requestChunkSize` as a floor rather than a cap: it runs
speculative read heads whose request size doubles, 4 KiB to 8 to 16 and onward past
a megabyte. On the 2,000-document demo database (5.9 MB) the first query pulls about
5.2 MB — effectively the whole file — in six requests. Those parameters
(`maxReadHeads`, `maxReadSpeed`) are internal to its lazy file and are not reachable
through the public `createDbWorker` config; passing them has no effect.

That behaviour is sensible for its intended use and fatal for measuring page
locality, which is why the demo also offers a bounded-Range transport reading the
flat sidecar files. See RESEARCH_LOG.md section 13.
